info.title: ANUClaw OCR study workspace API
info.description: Study tooling only — synthetic data does not establish OCR accuracy, clinical validation or release approval. Identity, tenant, study role and lock state are derived by the server from the dashboard session and database membership, never from request bodies. Storage fails closed unless configured; only a synthetic local adapter exists.
